notes: Stored edit: 'went' is the past tense every model holds (a suppletive form, from 'wend'). Related near asks whether 'went' is the past tense of 'go' (functional, answer; the earlier sentence-correctness version needed an unlisted bridge); related far whether the past of 'go' is regular (composition: 'goed' is go + '-ed'), stored because grammars state that 'went' is irregular and suppletive. The derived queries follow the edit to the new form (its first letter, a rhyme) or reach 'go' by another description (the verb whose present participle is 'going'; the verb whose past participle is 'gone': binding; the antonym of 'come' was dropped because it has several fair answers). Compound verbs such as 'undergo' and 'forgo' were dropped: their past forms ('underwent', 'forwent') are stored by name, so after the edit they could keep their old forms in a valid world (reviewer flags). Base form relations have no transitive or chain tag, so this record carries functional, composition and binding. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) taken when the record was first written; the infini-gram API refused requests (HTTP 403) during this migration, so new evidence uses Wikipedia quotes and Wikipedia exact-phrase searches.
